stem:
A movie theater has 710 seats.

• 158 seats are red.

• 247 seats are black.

• 119 seats are yellow.

• The rest of the seats are green.

How many seats are green?
visual_elements: The text layout with bulleted seat counts and four multiple choice answers labeled A through D
difficulty_rationale: The problem requires one straightforward step of subtracting known seat counts from the total to find the remaining green seats.
